/* WatchList 등록 (7040) */ /* AdminWatchListMapper.selectCtgrList */ SELECT A.AI_INPT_CTGR_ID, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_NM, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_TXT FROM CSPD102TI A WHERE A.AI_INPT_CTGR_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_CTGR_NM
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_CTGR_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_CTGR_NM
mapper.insert: /* WatchList 등록 (7040) */ /* AdminWatchListMapper.insertCtgr */ MERGE INTO CSPD102TI A USING DUAL ON (A.AI_INPT_CTGR_ID = #{aiInptCtgrId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.AI_INPT_CTGR_NM = #{aiInptCtgrNm}, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_TXT = #{aiInptCtgrTxt}, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.AI_INPT_CTGR_ID, A.CTGR_CFCD, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_NM, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_TXT, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_YN, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_RGS_DTM, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_END_DTM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM) VALUES (CSPD102TI_SG01.NEXTVAL, #{ctgrCfcd}, #{aiInptCtgrNm}, #{aiInptCtgrTxt}, 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))

/* WatchList 등록 (7040) */ /* AdminWatchListMapper.insertGrp */ MERGE INTO CSPD103TI A USING DUAL ON (A.AI_INPT_CTGR_ID = #{aiInptCtgrId} AND A.AI_INPT_LIST_ID = #{aiInptListId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.AI_INPT_LIST_NM = #{aiInptListNm}, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno}, A.AI_INPT_LIST_DES_TXT = #{aiInptListDesTxt}, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstDbChgId}, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.AI_INPT_CTGR_ID, A.AI_INPT_LIST_ID, A.AI_INPT_LIST_NM, A.AI_INPT_LIST_YN, A.AI_INPT_LIST_RGS_DTM, A.AI_INPT_LIST_END_DTM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, A.AI_INPT_LIST_DES_TXT) VALUES (#{aiInptCtgrId}, CSPD103TI_SG01.NEXTVAL, #{aiInptListNm}, 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), NULL, #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{aiInptListDesTxt})

/* WatchList 등록 (7040) */ /* AdminWatchListMapper.selectContList */ SELECT AI_INPT_LIST_ID, AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_SRNO, AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_DES_TXT, AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_YN, AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_RGS_DTM, AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_END_DTM, AI_INPT_CTGR_ID, TRN_LOG_SRNO, LST_DB_CHG_ID, LST_DB_CHG_DTM FROM CSPD104TI WHERE AI_INPT_CTGR_ID = #{aiInptCtgrId} AND AI_INPT_LIST_ID = #{aiInptListId}
AND AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_YN = 'Y'
AND AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_YN = 'N'
ORDER BY AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_DES_TXT
ORDER BY AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_DES_TXT DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_RGS_DTM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_RGS_DTM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_END_DTM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_END_DTM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_DES_TXT
mapper.insert: /* WatchList 등록 (7040) */ /* AdminWatchListMapper.insertCont */ MERGE INTO CSPD104TI A USING DUAL ON (A.AI_INPT_LIST_ID = #{aiInptListId} AND A.AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_SRNO = #{aiInptRsptTxtSrno}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_DES_TXT = #{aiInptRsptTxtDesTxt}, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.AI_INPT_LIST_ID, A.AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_SRNO, A.AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_DES_TXT, A.AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_YN, A.AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_RGS_DTM, A.AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_END_DTM, A.AI_INPT_CTGR_ID, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM) VALUES (#{aiInptListId}, (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_RSPT_TXT_SRNO) FROM CSPD104TI)+1, #{aiInptRsptTxtDesTxt}, 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), NULL, #{aiInptCtgrId}, #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))
